고린도전서 16:1.content: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.

고린도전서 16:2.content: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.

고린도전서 16:3.content: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.

고린도전서 16:4.content: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.

고린도전서 16:5.content: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.

고린도전서 16:6.content: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.

고린도전서 16:7.content: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

고린도전서 16:8.content: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.

고린도전서 16:9.content: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.

고린도전서 16:10.content: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.

고린도전서 16:11.content: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.

고린도전서 16:12.content: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.

고린도전서 16:13.content: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

고린도전서 16:14.content: Let all your things be done with charity.

고린도전서 16:15.content: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)

고린도전서 16:16.content: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.

고린도전서 16:17.content: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.

고린도전서 16:18.content: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.

고린도전서 16:19.content: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.

고린도전서 16:20.content: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.

고린도전서 16:21.content: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.

고린도전서 16:22.content: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maran-atha.

고린도전서 16:23.content: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

고린도전서 16:24.content: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen. The first epistle to the Corinthians was written from Philippi by Stephanas, and Fortunatus, and Achaicus, and Timotheus.
